treaty_name: Convention between the Republic of Armenia and the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income and on capital (2009, as modified by the MLI)
eif_quote: [LU list] Arménie - Armenia ... Synthesised Text EN | 04/01/2024 | ... Convention signée le 23/06/2009 | Mémorial A n° 51 de 2010, page 844 | à partir du 01/01/2011 || [AM MLI position] ...ital Grand Duchy of Luxembourg Original 23-06-2009 09-04-2010
source_title: Synthesised text of the MLI and the AM-LU Convention (MLISynthesizedTextLuxemburg.docx, Armenian MoF)

rates.quote: 5 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company (other than a partnership) which holds directly at least 10 per cent of the capital of the company paying the dividends;
15 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.
if the beneficial owner of the interest is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.
if the recipient is the beneficial owner of the royalties, the tax so charged shall not exceed 5 percent of the gross amount of the royalties.

ppt.quote: Notwithstanding any provisions of this Convention, a benefit under this Convention shall not be granted in respect of an item of income or capital if it is reasonable to conclude, having regard to all relevant facts and circumstances, that obtaining that benefit was one of the principal purposes of any arrangement or transaction that resulted directly or indirectly in that benefit

notes: Art. 11(3): interest taxable only in residence State if the beneficial owner is the State/local authority/statutory body, if paid by the source State or its local authority/statutory body, on loans owed to/guaranteed/insured by the State or its export financing agency, or on any loan granted by a bank. Art. 28: WHT on income derived on or after 1 January of the year following EIF (2010-04-09 -> 2011-01-01). Synthesised text: MLI effective for WHT where the event occurs on or after 1 January 2024. MLI Art. 8 not applied. An exchange of notes (exchange of information) forms part of the Convention; it does not change rates.
